answer: Reaching eligibility takes 63 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The ferrous register is checked at draw time, beacon lists the eligible set, and plume seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 63 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
